t: Powerful, semi-professional dehumidifier with infinity humidistat. Ideal for removing excess moisture during building projects, such as drying plaster or paint and dealing with minor floods and water ingress. Select a target humidity level and Powerdri will do the rest. Suitable for areas up to 165m²/330m³.
